items.title: Strata v0.2.16 moves local inference fully onto Strata's own engine, with a Mac bug fix and wider GPU support
items.summary: The release makes Strata's own engine the only path for local models, with a fix for a serious Mac bug. Users report faster prefill on older AMD cards, and early tests with parallel agents rely on KV-cache reuse.

doubt.pushback: Repliers ask why it still trails a rival engine (Basalt) and note the quoted 30 to 33 ms prefill depends on cached tokens; one reply says no improvement yet on a 7900 XTX.

reception.summary: Some repliers report big prefill gains (1000+ tokens/s on an older AMD card); others ask for cold-prompt numbers and comparisons against Basalt and llama.cpp, and one saw no gain on a 7900 XTX.

items.title: HyperFlow H3 Flash: Video Rebirth compresses MiniMax-H3 to 13.7B for joint video and audio generation in 4 to 8 steps, with GGUF
items.summary: Video Rebirth's compressed MiniMax-H3 makes video plus stereo audio in 4 to 8 steps; a Q4_K_M GGUF is 9.1 GB and fits a 24 GB card, though the text encoder needs another 15.7 GB. Official 5.2 s 1344x768 clips take 53 s on an RTX PRO 6000, 83 s on a 5090 and 152 s on a 4090.

items.title: ORA v0.1: open harness for zero-shot robot use lifts RoboDojo success from 5.2% to 39.9% on DeepSeek V4.1-Flash
items.summary: Hao AI Lab releases ORA v0.1 with cuRobo motion planning and a code mode where models write their own tools. Collision-stopped moves fell from 14.1% to 7.0% on RoboDojo, and a companion dataset of 3K+ episodes from 7 models (ORA Traces) is out.

items.title: Genie 4 in Project Genie lets users type new prompts while exploring a generated world, with audio adapting in real time
items.summary: Google says Genie 4 accepts new prompts mid-exploration, such as adding characters or changing the scene, and the native audio follows. It is available to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie.

doubt.pushback: No technical report or access beyond the Ultra tier is linked, so nothing outside Google's own demo can be checked yet.

reception.summary: Mostly short praise; one reply says live editing mid-walk changes how the world feels, and one questions training data.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon scores 63.7% on CursorBench 4.1 at default effort, up from 57.3% for Gemini 4 Hydrogen
items.summary: Cursor adds Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input and $15 per million output tokens and reports a new cost-performance frontier on its own CursorBench 4.1.

doubt.pushback: Repliers note it is Cursor's own eval on its own harness and ask which effort setting 'default' means, since provider defaults differ.

reception.summary: Mostly questions about the effort setting, task-length breakdown and cost per finished task; nobody reports an independent rerun.

items.title: Agent Arena Index debuts as Arena's headline agent measure, with GPT-6.2 Astra at #6 (1291) and Sol at #11 (1241)
items.summary: Arena scores GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol on its new Agent Arena Index, an overall measure of agent performance, with Sol on the cost Pareto frontier.

items.title: Kling Image 4.0 ranks #7 in text to image and #6 in image editing, with output up to 8K
items.summary: Artificial Analysis places Kling Image 4.0 just behind OpenAI and Microsoft AI image models, at under a third of the 2K price of every higher-ranked OpenAI model.

items.title: Humming in SGLang adds JIT low-bit kernels for dense and MoE layers on NVIDIA GPUs from Turing to Blackwell
items.summary: LMSYS describes Humming, which keeps Hopper MoE expert weights packed at 4 bits and rebuilds FP8 operands in-kernel for more efficient MoE serving.

doubt.pushback: The post links no repo, paper or numbers in the part available, so there is nothing to check yet.

items.title: GitHub Copilot rolls out GitHub-verified MCP servers as one-time connectors in public preview
items.summary: Verified MCP connectors can be added once and used across the Copilot app, Copilot CLI and VS Code, with sign-in handled per service.

items.title: Prime Intellect launches Model Factory to train, deploy and continuously improve models on one stack, with nanochat-ladder autoresearch
items.summary: Model Factory runs on demand, on dedicated clusters or on your own, and a new pretraining feature supports autoresearch on top of the nanochat scaling ladder with automatic recovery for jobs on thousands of GPUs.

doubt.pushback: Replies are congratulations and integration chatter; no one reports using it and no docs or numbers appear in the thread.

reception.summary: Congratulations and small integration comments; nobody reports a result.

items.title: Replit announces Missions, extending its Agent past 200-minute autonomous runs
items.summary: Replit says Missions pushes its Agent further than the 200-plus minutes of autonomous work it reached in September 2025; the post gives no mechanism or numbers.

doubt.pushback: Repliers ask how long a mission can run, which model grades the work and how rollbacks work; the post has no numbers to check.

reception.summary: Three replies, all questions about run length, grading model and rollbacks.

items.title: DHH has local models build themes, bar plugins, apps and games on Omarchy overnight, fixing Omarchy after each failure
items.summary: Two Omarchy pull requests make the desktop easier for local models to build on, based on an overnight run of Qwen3.8 Flash Next at about 45 tokens/s on Strix Halo driving OpenCode through four make-tasks.

items.title: Amp ships a Windows version
items.summary: Sourcegraph's Amp coding agent now has a Windows app, announced with a short post and a link.

doubt.pushback: The post has no details to check beyond the link.
